messages:
maya (DevEx): Heads up — ran into a weird retry that caused duplicate tool invocations in the Python SDK when using async function-calls + structured outputs. Repro below. @devex-team :eyes:

sam (Py SDK): Ugh. Can you paste a minimal repro and the HTTP logs?

maya (DevEx): Repro gist (simplified):
```py
# repro.py
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=env['RW_KEY'])

async def run():
    res = await client.fn_call(
        model='gpt-4r',
        fn_name='get_user',
        fn_schema={"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}}},
        input='fetch user 123',
        structured_output=True,
    )
    print(res)

# run with asyncio.run(run())
```

maya (DevEx): Observed behavior: the backend receives two tool invocations for the single request. First call has Authorization header, second call does not. The SDK then attempts to parse two structured outputs concatenated -> JSON parsing error.

olivia (QA): Reproduced locally (macos, py3.11). HTTP traces:
```
--> POST /v1/tools/get_user  Authorization: Bearer xxxxx  (200)
--> POST /v1/tools/get_user  Authorization:  (500)
```
Looks like retry happens but auth header missing on retry. :bug:

leo (Backend): Could be that the retry uses a new request object and the auth hook isn't applied, or the ticket that copies headers is skipping on streaming/async path. We changed some internals last month for continuous batching.

sam (Py SDK): Which SDK version? httpx version? Any custom middleware? Also, is this happening only when structured_output=True?

maya (DevEx): Redwood SDK 0.12.3, httpx 0.24.0. No custom middleware. Yes — haven't reproduced with plain text generation. Structured outputs + fn_call seems to correlate.

sam (Py SDK): Thanks. Quick hypothesis: our retry code reconstructs the request for the second attempt but doesn't run the auth hook (we rely on `client._auth_hook` to mutate headers). In async path the coroutine that adds headers may have already awaited and not been re-run. Workaround: set explicit header via client.session.headers.update({'Authorization': f'Bearer {KEY}'}) or disable automatic retry for fn_calls.

maya (DevEx): Confirmed workaround: setting session header fixed the duplicate/no-auth retry locally. But that's not great for users.

olivia (QA): Also saw the structured parser error. Example parser error in logs: `json.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 345 (char 344)` because the body contained two concatenated JSON fragments (tool output then retry body).

sam (Py SDK): Can you run with `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug` and paste the <request id> for the failing trace? I'll open a ticket and try a patch to ensure auth hook runs on retries for async requests.

maya (DevEx): Got it. Debug trace: request_id=rq_03f9a8c2. Pasted to the issue.

sam (Py SDK): Filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/issues/1187 — title: "async fn_call: retry loses Authorization header and causes duplicate tool outputs". I'll put up a small fix branch to re-run auth hook when building retry request.

leo (Backend): Also good to add defensive parsing server-side: if we get two concatenated JSON outputs, return 5xx so client can surface clearer error; but fix in SDK is priority.

sam (Py SDK): Agreed. I'll add a unit test that simulates an auth-missing retry and assert we don't send retry without headers. Putting up PR in a couple hours.

maya (DevEx): Thanks! One ask: can we add a short note in the Python SDK upgrade guide about the header behavior and the temporary workaround? A couple of customers hit this during onboarding.

sam (Py SDK): Will do. Also tagging @ci-bot to run the branch tests.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch fix/retry-auth-1187 — run started.

olivia (QA): After the patch landed in my local branch (sam's diff), I re-ran the repro and only a single toolcall appeared. Parser error gone. :tada:

maya (DevEx): Awesome. Thanks team — landing this will unblock a few customer sample apps that hit this during onboarding.

sam (Py SDK): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1190 — includes test + changelog note. I'll backport to 0.12.x patch once merged.

maya (DevEx): Leaving this thread here for follow-up docs and a short snippet for the onboarding guide.
